---

The project at a glance, one card per topic. Pick a tile to dig in.

```{r}
#| label: cards
#| include: false
library(bslib)
library(htmltools)

tile <- function(title, desc, href) {
  bslib::card(
    bslib::card_header(
      tags$h3(class = "mb-0", tags$a(href = href, title))
    ),
    tags$p(class = "fs-5 mb-0", desc),
    fillable = FALSE,
    style = css(min_height = "9rem")
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: grid
#| echo: false
bslib::layout_columns(
  tile("About", "The project in brief.", "about.html"),
  tile("Analysis", "Write-ups: who gets drafted, associations, forecasts.", "analysis.html"),
  tile("Data & provenance", "Sources, grains, and how each table is built.", "data.html"),
  tile("Visualizations", "Interactive exemplars of the project's chart families.", "visualizations.html"),
  tile("Pipeline", "The targets DAG from ingest to report.", "pipeline.html"),
  col_widths = c(12, 6, 6, 6, 6, 12)
)
```
